Header composition (GlobalSearch / NotificationCenter / SecurityMenu / MobileNotificationBadge) integrates cleanly; all previous data-testid contracts preserved (header-title, global-search-input, global-search-results, global-search-result-*, header-notifications-button, notifications-dropdown, header-notifications-count, notification-dismiss-*, header-security-button, security-dropdown, security-logout-all).
